<# .SYNOPSIS Machine-wide configuration for a workgroup Windows 11 Pro PC. Runs once, as SYSTEM, during the "specialize" pass of Windows Setup. .NOTES Every section is controlled by a switch in $Config below. This block is what a future constructor UI will generate; everything else is meant to stay stable. Log: C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs\Setup-System.log #>
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# ============================================================================ # CONFIGURATION (the part a constructor UI would generate) # ============================================================================ $Config = @{ # --- Users (must match <LocalAccounts> in the answer file) --- AdminAccount = 'Admin' UserAccount = 'User' PasswordNeverExpires = $true # blank passwords must not "expire" after 42 days
# --- Installation media --- EnableNetFx3 = $true # .NET Framework 3.5 from <media>\sources\sxs if present
# --- Printing --- EnsurePrintSpooler = $true # Spooler = Automatic, running RestrictPrinterDriverInstallToAdmins = $true # PrintNightmare mitigation (Windows default since 2021)
# --- Windows Update --- WindowsUpdateAutomatic = $true # AUOptions=4, active hours 08:00-20:00 UpdateOtherMicrosoftProducts = $true # Office etc. through Windows Update DeferFeatureUpdatesDays = 90 # 0 = do not defer yearly feature updates DeliveryOptimizationLANOnly = $true # peer download inside the LAN only
# --- Microsoft Defender --- DefenderCloudProtection = $true # MAPS advanced + safe sample submission + cloud block level High DefenderPUAProtection = $true # block potentially unwanted apps (adware, bundlers) DefenderNetworkProtection = $true # block connections to known-malicious hosts DefenderASRRules = $true # attack surface reduction rules (see $AsrRules) ControlledFolderAccess = 0 # 0 off, 1 block, 2 audit. Anti-ransomware, but breaks legacy apps writing to Documents.
# --- Accounts / privileges --- UACAlwaysNotify = $true # admins: consent on secure desktop for every elevation LSAProtection = $true # RunAsPPL: protect LSASS from credential dumping AccountLockout = $true # 10 failed attempts -> 15 minutes lockout InactivityLockSeconds = 900 # lock screen after 15 min idle (0 = off) DisableRemoteAssistance = $true DisableRemoteDesktopInbound = $true # Windows default; set explicitly DisableRemoteRegistry = $true
# --- Network / SMB --- DisableSMB1 = $true RequireSMBSigning = $true # both server and client NTLMv2Only = $true # LmCompatibilityLevel=5 DisableLLMNR = $true # stops LLMNR poisoning (responder-style attacks) DisableNetBIOS = $false # also stops NBT-NS poisoning but may break name resolution in old workgroups FirewallOnWithLogging = $true
# --- Removable media / scripts / downloads --- DisableAutoRun = $true # no AutoRun/AutoPlay for any drive type ScriptFilesOpenInNotepad = $true # .js .jse .vbs .vbe .wsf .wsh .hta open in Notepad on double-click RemoveVBScript = $false # remove the deprecated VBScript engine entirely (breaks old installers) SmartScreenLevel = 'Warn' # 'Warn' or 'Block' for unrecognised downloaded apps EdgeSmartScreenLocked = $true # Edge SmartScreen on, user cannot bypass
# --- Logging for incident response --- AuditLogging = $true # process creation with command line, logon events, bigger event logs PowerShellLogging = $true # script block + module logging DisablePowerShellV2 = $true # old engine bypasses logging/AMSI
# --- Privacy / noise --- MinimalTelemetry = $true # AllowTelemetry=1 (Required), no feedback nags, no CEIP tasks DisableConsumerContent = $true # no promoted apps, tips, Spotlight ads DisableCopilotAndRecall = $true DisableWidgetsAndNews = $true DisableWebSearchInStart = $true
# --- Apps --- RemoveBloatApps = $true # see $AppsToRemove (Store, Photos, Paint, Calculator etc. are KEPT) RemoveQuickAssist = $true # Quick Assist is abused by "tech support" scammers RemoveXboxServices = $true
# --- Disk encryption --- PreventAutoDeviceEncryption = $true # no silent BitLocker without a stored recovery key (local accounts have nowhere to store it) }
# Apps removed from the image (provisioned) and from any existing profile. # Deliberately NOT removed: Microsoft.WindowsStore, Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller (winget), # Microsoft.Windows.Photos, Microsoft.Paint, Microsoft.WindowsCalculator, Microsoft.WindowsNotepad, # Microsoft.ScreenSketch, Microsoft.WindowsCamera, Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder, # Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes, Microsoft.WindowsTerminal, Microsoft.ZuneMusic, Microsoft.ZuneVideo, # Microsoft.WindowsAlarms, Microsoft.WindowsScan, Microsoft.SecHealthUI, Microsoft Edge, OneDrive. $AppsToRemove = @( 'Microsoft.BingSearch' 'Microsoft.BingNews' 'Microsoft.BingWeather' 'Microsoft.GetHelp' 'Microsoft.Getstarted' 'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub' 'Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer' 'Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal' 'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection' 'Microsoft.GamingApp' 'Microsoft.XboxApp' 'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay' 'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay' 'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider' 'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay' 'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI' 'Microsoft.Edge.GameAssist' 'Microsoft.WindowsMaps' 'Microsoft.People' 'Microsoft.YourPhone' 'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop' 'Microsoft.Todos' 'MicrosoftCorporationII.MicrosoftFamily' 'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome' 'Clipchamp.Clipchamp' 'MSTeams' 'Microsoft.SkypeApp' 'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub' 'Microsoft.OutlookForWindows' 'microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps' 'Microsoft.Copilot' 'Microsoft.Windows.Ai.Copilot.Provider' 'Microsoft.549981C3F5F10' )
# Attack surface reduction rules. Value: 1 = block, 2 = audit (log only), 6 = warn (user can allow). $AsrRules = @{ '56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5' = 1 # Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers 'e6db77e5-3df2-4cf1-b95a-636979351e5b' = 1 # Block persistence through WMI event subscription '7674ba52-37eb-4a4f-a9a1-f0f9a1619a2c' = 1 # Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes 'd4f940ab-401b-4efc-aadc-ad5f3c50688a' = 1 # Block all Office applications from creating child processes 'be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550' = 1 # Block executable content from email client and webmail '5beb7efe-fd9a-4556-801d-275e5ffc04cc' = 1 # Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts 'd3e037e1-3eb8-44c8-a917-57927947596d' = 1 # Block JavaScript/VBScript from launching downloaded executable content '3b576869-a4ec-4529-8536-b80a7769e899' = 1 # Block Office applications from creating executable content '75668c1f-73b5-4cf0-bb93-3ecf5cb7cc84' = 1 # Block Office applications from injecting code into other processes '26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869' = 1 # Block Office communication application from creating child processes 'b2b3f03d-6a65-4f7b-a9c7-1c7ef74a9ba4' = 1 # Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB '92e97fa1-2edf-4476-bdd6-9dd0b4dddc7b' = 1 # Block Win32 API calls from Office macros 'c1db55ab-c21a-4637-bb3f-a12568109d35' = 1 # Use advanced protection against ransomware '33ddedf1-c6e0-47cb-833e-de6133960387' = 1 # Block rebooting machine in Safe Mode 'c0033c00-d16d-4114-a5a0-dc9b3a7d2ceb' = 6 # Block use of copied or impersonated system tools (warn: heuristic) '01443614-cd74-433a-b99e-2ecdc07bfc25' = 2 # Block executables by prevalence/age (audit: would block rare local software) 'd1e49aac-8f56-4280-b9ba-993a6d77406c' = 2 # Block process creations from PSExec/WMI (audit: admins may need it) # '9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2' LSASS rule is redundant when LSA protection is on }
# ============================================================================ # HELPERS # ============================================================================ $LogDir = 'C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs' $LogPath = Join-Path $LogDir 'Setup-System.log' $null = New-Item -Path $LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
function Write-Log { param([string]$Message, [string]$Level = 'INFO') $line = '[{0}] [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $LogPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 }
function Set-Reg { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('DWord','QWord','String','ExpandString','MultiString','Binary')][string]$Type, [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyString()][AllowNull()]$Value, [string]$Why = '' ) try { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { $null = New-Item -Path $Path -Force } Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Path -Name $Name -Value $Value -Type $Type -Force Write-Log ("{0}\{1} = {2} {3}" -f $Path, $Name, ($Value -join ','), $Why) 'OK' } catch { Write-Log ("FAILED {0}\{1}: {2}" -f $Path, $Name, $_.Exception.Message) 'ERROR' } }
function Remove-Reg { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name) try { if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) -and ($null -ne (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Path -Name $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))) { Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Path -Name $Name -Force Write-Log ("removed {0}\{1}" -f $Path, $Name) 'OK' } } catch { Write-Log ("FAILED to remove {0}\{1}: {2}" -f $Path, $Name, $_.Exception.Message) 'ERROR' } }
function Set-ServiceStart { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory)][int]$Start) # 2 auto, 3 manual, 4 disabled $key = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$Name" if (Test-Path $key) { Set-Reg -Path $key -Name 'Start' -Type DWord -Value $Start -Why "service $Name" } else { Write-Log "service $Name not present, skipped" } }
function Invoke-Exe { # Runs a native executable directly (no cmd.exe quoting problems) and logs its exit code. param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$File, [string[]]$Arguments = @()) try { $out = & $File @Arguments 2>&1 $code = $LASTEXITCODE Write-Log ("{0} {1} -> exit {2}" -f $File, ($Arguments -join ' '), $code) $(if ($code -eq 0) { 'OK' } else { 'WARN' }) if ($code -ne 0 -and $out) { Write-Log (($out | Out-String).Trim()) 'WARN' } } catch { Write-Log ("FAILED {0} {1}: {2}" -f $File, ($Arguments -join ' '), $_.Exception.Message) 'ERROR' } }
# Any unexpected terminating error is logged and execution continues with the next statement. # Windows Setup aborts the whole installation if this script ends with a non-zero exit code. trap { Write-Log ("UNHANDLED: {0} (line {1})" -f $_.Exception.Message, $_.InvocationInfo.ScriptLineNumber) 'ERROR'; continue }
if (-not (Get-PSDrive -Name HKU -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $null = New-PSDrive -Name HKU -PSProvider Registry -Root HKEY_USERS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Write-Log '================================================================' Write-Log 'Setup-System.ps1 started' Write-Log ("Build: {0} User: {1}" -f [System.Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Build, $env:USERNAME)
$Pol = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows'
# ============================================================================ # 0. .NET FRAMEWORK 3.5 FROM THE INSTALLATION MEDIA (needed by older line-of-business apps) # ============================================================================ if ($Config.EnableNetFx3) { $src = $null foreach ($d in [System.IO.DriveInfo]::GetDrives()) { try { if (-not $d.IsReady) { continue } $p = Join-Path $d.RootDirectory.FullName 'sources\sxs' if ((Test-Path $p) -and (Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Filter '*.cab' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $src = $p; break } } catch { } } if ($src) { Invoke-Exe 'dism.exe' @('/Online','/Enable-Feature','/FeatureName:NetFx3','/All','/LimitAccess',"/Source:$src",'/NoRestart','/Quiet') } else { Write-Log 'sources\sxs not found on any drive, .NET 3.5 skipped (can be added later from Windows Update)' 'WARN' } }
# ============================================================================ # 1. PRINTING # ============================================================================ if ($Config.EnsurePrintSpooler) { Set-ServiceStart -Name 'Spooler' -Start 2 Set-ServiceStart -Name 'PrintNotify' -Start 3 try { Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log 'Spooler startup type = Automatic' 'OK' } catch { Write-Log "Set-Service Spooler: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'WARN' } } if ($Config.RestrictPrinterDriverInstallToAdmins) { $pp = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers\PointAndPrint' Set-Reg -Path $pp -Name 'RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'PrintNightmare' Set-Reg -Path $pp -Name 'NoWarningNoElevationOnInstall' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path $pp -Name 'UpdatePromptSettings' -Type DWord -Value 0 }
# ============================================================================ # 2. WINDOWS UPDATE (keep it working, make it automatic) # ============================================================================ $wu = "$Pol\WindowsUpdate" $au = "$Pol\WindowsUpdate\AU" # Remove anything that could disable updates (never present on a clean image, but be explicit) Remove-Reg -Path $au -Name 'NoAutoUpdate' Remove-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DoNotConnectToWindowsUpdateInternetLocations' Remove-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DisableWindowsUpdateAccess' Remove-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'ExcludeWUDriversInQualityUpdate' Remove-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsStore' -Name 'AutoDownload' if ($Config.WindowsUpdateAutomatic) { Set-Reg -Path $au -Name 'NoAutoUpdate' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path $au -Name 'AUOptions' -Type DWord -Value 4 -Why 'auto download and install' Set-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'SetActiveHours' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'ActiveHoursStart' -Type DWord -Value 8 Set-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'ActiveHoursEnd' -Type DWord -Value 20 } if ($Config.UpdateOtherMicrosoftProducts) { Set-Reg -Path $au -Name 'AllowMUUpdateService' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'Office and other Microsoft products via WU' } if ($Config.DeferFeatureUpdatesDays -gt 0) { Set-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdates' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays' -Type DWord -Value $Config.DeferFeatureUpdatesDays -Why 'security updates are never deferred' } else { Remove-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdates' Remove-Reg -Path $wu -Name 'DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays' } if ($Config.DeliveryOptimizationLANOnly) { Set-Reg -Path "$Pol\DeliveryOptimization" -Name 'DODownloadMode' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'LAN peers only' } foreach ($svc in 'wuauserv','UsoSvc','BITS','DoSvc','WaaSMedicSvc') { $key = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$svc" if (Test-Path $key) { $cur = (Get-ItemProperty $key -Name Start -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Start if ($cur -eq 4) { Set-Reg -Path $key -Name 'Start' -Type DWord -Value 3 -Why 're-enable update service' } } }
# ============================================================================ # 3. MICROSOFT DEFENDER (keep it on, harden it) # ============================================================================ $def = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender' Remove-Reg -Path $def -Name 'DisableAntiSpyware' Remove-Reg -Path $def -Name 'DisableAntiVirus' Remove-Reg -Path "$def\Real-Time Protection" -Name 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring' Set-Reg -Path "$def\Real-Time Protection" -Name 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path "$def\Real-Time Protection" -Name 'DisableBehaviorMonitoring' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path "$def\Real-Time Protection" -Name 'DisableIOAVProtection' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path "$def\Real-Time Protection" -Name 'DisableScriptScanning' -Type DWord -Value 0 if ($Config.DefenderCloudProtection) { Set-Reg -Path "$def\Spynet" -Name 'SpynetReporting' -Type DWord -Value 2 -Why 'MAPS advanced' Set-Reg -Path "$def\Spynet" -Name 'SubmitSamplesConsent' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'send safe samples automatically' Set-Reg -Path "$def\MpEngine" -Name 'MpCloudBlockLevel' -Type DWord -Value 2 -Why 'cloud block level High' Set-Reg -Path "$def\MpEngine" -Name 'MpBafsExtendedTimeout' -Type DWord -Value 50 } if ($Config.DefenderPUAProtection) { Set-Reg -Path $def -Name 'PUAProtection' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'block potentially unwanted apps' } if ($Config.DefenderNetworkProtection) { Set-Reg -Path "$def\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection" -Name 'EnableNetworkProtection' -Type DWord -Value 1 } if ($Config.DefenderASRRules) { $asr = "$def\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\ASR" Set-Reg -Path $asr -Name 'ExploitGuard_ASR_Rules' -Type DWord -Value 1 foreach ($rule in $AsrRules.GetEnumerator()) { Set-Reg -Path "$asr\Rules" -Name $rule.Key -Type String -Value ([string]$rule.Value) -Why 'ASR rule' } } Set-Reg -Path "$def\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Controlled Folder Access" -Name 'EnableControlledFolderAccess' -Type DWord -Value ([int]$Config.ControlledFolderAccess) # Security Center notifications must stay visible Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Notifications' -Name 'DisableNotifications' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Notifications' -Name 'DisableEnhancedNotifications' -Type DWord -Value 0 # Windows SmartScreen for downloaded apps (Explorer) Set-Reg -Path "$Pol\System" -Name 'EnableSmartScreen' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path "$Pol\System" -Name 'ShellSmartScreenLevel' -Type String -Value $Config.SmartScreenLevel
# ============================================================================ # 4. ACCOUNTS, UAC, LSA, REMOTE ACCESS # ============================================================================ $sys = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'EnableLUA' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'UAC on' Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'PromptOnSecureDesktop' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin' -Type DWord -Value $(if ($Config.UACAlwaysNotify) { 2 } else { 5 }) -Why 'UAC level for admins' Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'ConsentPromptBehaviorUser' -Type DWord -Value 3 -Why 'standard users: ask for admin credentials on secure desktop' Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'EnableInstallerDetection' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'FilterAdministratorToken' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Why 'no remote admin token for local accounts' if ($Config.InactivityLockSeconds -gt 0) { Set-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'InactivityTimeoutSecs' -Type DWord -Value $Config.InactivityLockSeconds -Why 'lock after idle' } # Win+L must work: the lock-workstation policy lives under Policies\System; make sure it is absent everywhere. Remove-Reg -Path $sys -Name 'DisableLockWorkstation' Remove-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' -Name 'DisableLockWorkstation'
$lsa = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' if ($Config.LSAProtection) { Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'RunAsPPL' -Type DWord -Value 2 -Why 'LSA protection (no UEFI lock)' } Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'NoLMHash' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'LimitBlankPasswordUse' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'blank passwords: console only' Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'RestrictAnonymous' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'RestrictAnonymousSAM' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'EveryoneIncludesAnonymous' -Type DWord -Value 0 if ($Config.NTLMv2Only) { Set-Reg -Path $lsa -Name 'LmCompatibilityLevel' -Type DWord -Value 5 -Why 'NTLMv2 only' } Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest' -Name 'UseLogonCredential' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Why 'no plaintext creds in memory' Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel' -Name 'DisableExceptionChainValidation' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Why 'SEHOP on'
if ($Config.AccountLockout) { Invoke-Exe 'net.exe' @('accounts','/lockoutthreshold:10','/lockoutduration:15','/lockoutwindow:15') } if ($Config.PasswordNeverExpires) { # Starter accounts have blank passwords; without this Windows demands a "password change" after 42 days. # Applied here (always runs) and again per account in Post-OOBE.ps1. The user-provisioning project may override it. Invoke-Exe 'net.exe' @('accounts','/maxpwage:unlimited') } if ($Config.DisableRemoteAssistance) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance' -Name 'fAllowToGetHelp' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance' -Name 'fAllowFullControl' -Type DWord -Value 0 } if ($Config.DisableRemoteDesktopInbound) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name 'fDenyTSConnections' -Type DWord -Value 1 } Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -Name 'UserAuthentication' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'NLA if RDP is ever enabled' if ($Config.DisableRemoteRegistry) { Set-ServiceStart -Name 'RemoteRegistry' -Start 4 } if ($Config.PreventAutoDeviceEncryption) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker' -Name 'PreventDeviceEncryption' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'no silent BitLocker; enable deliberately with a saved recovery key' } Set-Reg -Path "$Pol\WorkplaceJoin" -Name 'BlockAADWorkplaceJoin' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'no "let your organisation manage this device" prompts'
# ============================================================================ # 5. NETWORK / SMB # ============================================================================ $srv = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' $wks = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters' if ($Config.DisableSMB1) { Set-Reg -Path $srv -Name 'SMB1' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-ServiceStart -Name 'mrxsmb10' -Start 4 try { $f = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName 'SMB1Protocol' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($f -and $f.State -ne 'Disabled') { $null = Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName 'SMB1Protocol' -NoRestart -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log 'SMB1Protocol feature disabled' 'OK' } } catch { Write-Log "SMB1Protocol: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'WARN' } } if ($Config.RequireSMBSigning) { Set-Reg -Path $srv -Name 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $srv -Name 'EnableSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $wks -Name 'RequireSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $wks -Name 'EnableSecuritySignature' -Type DWord -Value 1 } if ($Config.DisableLLMNR) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient' -Name 'EnableMulticast' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Why 'LLMNR off' } if ($Config.DisableNetBIOS) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters' -Name 'NodeType' -Type DWord -Value 2 -Why 'P-node: no NBT broadcasts' Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Set-Reg -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'NetbiosOptions' -Type DWord -Value 2 -Why 'NetBIOS over TCP/IP off' } } if ($Config.FirewallOnWithLogging) { foreach ($profile in 'DomainProfile','PrivateProfile','PublicProfile') { $fp = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\$profile" Set-Reg -Path $fp -Name 'EnableFirewall' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $fp -Name 'DefaultInboundAction' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'block inbound by default' Set-Reg -Path $fp -Name 'DefaultOutboundAction' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path "$fp\Logging" -Name 'LogDroppedPackets' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path "$fp\Logging" -Name 'LogFileSize' -Type DWord -Value 16384 Set-Reg -Path "$fp\Logging" -Name 'LogFilePath' -Type String -Value '%systemroot%\system32\LogFiles\Firewall\pfirewall.log' } }
# ============================================================================ # 6. REMOVABLE MEDIA, SCRIPT FILES, BROWSER # ============================================================================ if ($Config.DisableAutoRun) { Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Type DWord -Value 255 -Why 'AutoRun off for all drives' Set-Reg -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoAutorun' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path "$Pol\Explorer" -Name 'NoAutoplayfornonVolume' -Type DWord -Value 1 } if ($Config.ScriptFilesOpenInNotepad) { $notepad = '"%SystemRoot%\System32\notepad.exe" "%1"' foreach ($progId in 'JSFile','JSEFile','VBSFile','VBEFile','WSFFile','WSHFile','htafile') { Set-Reg -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Classes\$progId\Shell\Open\Command" -Name '(Default)' -Type ExpandString -Value $notepad -Why 'double-click opens in Notepad, cscript/wscript still work from a command line' } } if ($Config.RemoveVBScript) { try { Get-WindowsCapability -Online -Name 'VBSCRIPT*' -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object State -eq 'Installed' | ForEach-Object { $null = Remove-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $_.Name -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log "removed capability $($_.Name)" 'OK' } } catch { Write-Log "VBSCRIPT capability: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'WARN' } } # Microsoft Edge is kept as the recovery browser; policies only harden it. $edge = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' if ($Config.EdgeSmartScreenLocked) { Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'SmartScreenEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'SmartScreenPuaEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'PreventSmartScreenPromptOverride' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'PreventSmartScreenPromptOverrideForFiles' -Type DWord -Value 1 } Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'HideFirstRunExperience' -Type DWord -Value 1 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'ShowRecommendationsEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'PersonalizationReportingEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'StartupBoostEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 Set-Reg -Path $edge -Name 'BackgroundModeEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0
# ============================================================================ # 7. LOGGING FOR INCIDENT RESPONSE # ============================================================================ if ($Config.AuditLogging) { Set-Reg -Path "$sys\Audit" -Name 'ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Why 'command line in event 4688' # Subcategories by GUID: names are localized (Ukrainian image) and auditpol rejects English names there. $auditOn = @{ '{0CCE922B-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' = 'Process Creation' '{0CCE9215-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' = 'Logon' '{0CCE9216-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' = 'Logoff' <#
.SYNOPSIS
    Per-user settings. Started by Active Setup once at the first sign-in of every user
    (runs as that user, without elevation).
    Sets the input language list to: English (US), Ukrainian, Russian (Ukraine).
    Keeps the current display language untouched.
#>
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# One log per user: a file created by the first user is not writable by the next one under ProgramData.
$log = "C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs\Setup-User.$($env:USERNAME).log"
function Write-Log { param([string]$m) try { Add-Content -Path $log -Value ('[{0}] [{1}] {2}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $env:USERNAME, $m) -Encoding UTF8 } catch {} }

Write-Log 'Setup-User.ps1 started'
try {
    # Pin the display language to what is installed so that reordering input languages never changes the UI language.
    $ui = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InstalledUICulture.Name
    if ($ui) { Set-WinUILanguageOverride -Language $ui; Write-Log "display language pinned to $ui" }
} catch { Write-Log "display language override: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

$done = $false
try {
    $list = New-WinUserLanguageList 'en-US'
    $list.Add('uk-UA')
    $list.Add('ru-UA')          # "Russian (Ukraine)": Windows assigns a transient id (2000:00000419) and the Russian layout itself
    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList $list -Force 3>$null
    $applied = Get-WinUserLanguageList
    $ru = $applied | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq 'ru-UA' }
    if ($ru -and @($ru.InputMethodTips).Count -gt 0) {
        $done = $true
        Write-Log ('applied: ' + (($applied | ForEach-Object { $_.LanguageTag + '[' + ($_.InputMethodTips -join ',') + ']' }) -join ' '))
    } else {
        Write-Log 'ru-UA has no keyboard layout after apply, falling back to plain Russian'
    }
} catch { Write-Log "ru-UA attempt failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
if (-not $done) {
    try {
        $list = New-WinUserLanguageList 'en-US'; $list.Add('uk-UA'); $list.Add('ru')
        Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList $list -Force 3>$null
        Write-Log 'fallback applied: en-US, uk-UA, ru'
    } catch { Write-Log "fallback failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}
Write-Log 'Setup-User.ps1 finished'
exit 0

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Runs as SYSTEM at every startup until OOBE has completed, then:
      - marks the local accounts' blank passwords as never expiring,
      - makes sure the built-in Administrator and Guest stay disabled,
      - deletes the answer-file copies Windows leaves in C:\Windows\Panther
        (they contain account names and, when passwords are used, the passwords in clear text),
      - removes itself.
#>
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$log = 'C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs\Post-OOBE.log'
function Write-Log { param([string]$m) try { Add-Content -Path $log -Value ('[{0}] {1}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $m) -Encoding UTF8 } catch {} }

Write-Log 'Post-OOBE.ps1 started'
$stateKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Setup\State'
$deadline = (Get-Date).AddHours(5)
while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    $state = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $stateKey -Name ImageState -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ImageState
    if ($state -eq 'IMAGE_STATE_COMPLETE') { break }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
}
if ($state -ne 'IMAGE_STATE_COMPLETE') { Write-Log "OOBE still not complete ($state), will retry at next startup"; exit 0 }
Write-Log 'OOBE complete, waiting 2 minutes for the first sign-in to settle'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 120

$cfg = $null
try { $cfg = Get-Content 'C:\ProgramData\Unattend\config.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-Log "config.json unreadable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
$accounts = @('Admin','User')
if ($cfg) { $accounts = @($cfg.AdminAccount, $cfg.UserAccount) | Where-Object { $_ } }

foreach ($name in $accounts) {
    try {
        $u = Get-LocalUser -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop
        if (-not $cfg -or $cfg.PasswordNeverExpires) { Set-LocalUser -Name $name -PasswordNeverExpires $true -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log "$name : password never expires" }
    } catch { Write-Log "$name : $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}
# Built-in Administrator (RID 500) and Guest (RID 501) are found by SID: their names are localized on non-English images.
try {
    foreach ($u in (Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID.Value -match '-50[01]$' })) {
        if ($u.Enabled) { Disable-LocalUser -SID $u.SID; Write-Log "built-in account $($u.Name) disabled" } else { Write-Log "built-in account $($u.Name) already disabled" }
    }
} catch { Write-Log "built-in accounts: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

# Errors written by the specialize-pass wrappers (script missing or crashed) are kept next to the other logs.
if (Test-Path 'C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err') {
    try { Get-Content 'C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err' | ForEach-Object { Write-Log "SPECIALIZE ERROR: $_" }; Remove-Item 'C:\Windows\Temp\ua.err' -Force } catch { }
}

foreach ($f in 'C:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml','C:\Windows\Panther\unattend-original.xml','C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend\unattend.xml','C:\Windows\System32\Sysprep\unattend.xml','C:\unattend.xml','C:\autounattend.xml') {
    if (Test-Path $f) {
        try { Remove-Item -Path $f -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Log "deleted $f" } catch { Write-Log "could not delete $f : $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
}

try { $null = & schtasks.exe /Delete /TN 'Unattend-PostOOBE' /F 2>&1; Write-Log "task removed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" } catch { Write-Log "task removal: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Log 'Post-OOBE.ps1 finished'
exit 0
